name: Firetower
author: The Firetower
description: The Firetower in the bar: binoculars, dim when every watch is clear, lit with a count when something needs a look, red on fire. Click for a panel with the board's summary; right click opens the board.

barWidget.description: Background watches from the Firetower (firetower bar). Click for the panel, right click for the board.
